name: WayriCAD Layer Counter
description: Generate movable copper-layer counters with zone keepouts.
description_full: Create physical L1, L2 and other copper-layer numbers as one native layout group, including a multilayer zone-only rule area. Twelve layout styles include mirrored and overlapping explicit core pairs, circular, square, rectangular, octagonal and staggered counters. Read-only preview, explicit insertion, stale-state protection and in-window Undo/Redo. Includes CLI generation of new candidate boards. Core pair definitions are explicit; presets are not certified fabrication standards.
